## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 💄 UI / Styling refinement
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Tooling / Build / CI update

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project ([AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) / [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] I have run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format:check` with no errors.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm test:all` (Frontend Vitest + Backend Cargo tests) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (if applicable).
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
